description.value: The Balfour is a heritage bed and breakfast housed in a 1902 mansion in Vancouver's historic Shaughnessy neighbourhood, featuring handpainted ceilings and faux-finished walls that preserve the character of the original building. Guests can explore surrounding landscaped gardens or walk to the Van Dusen Botanical Garden and Queen Elizabeth Park. The property offers a mix of rooms with full ensuite and semi-private bathrooms, and is well-positioned for transit access to downtown Vancouver.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and provides detailed content across multiple subpages. A key phone number discrepancy exists: OSM lists +1-604-733-4774 but the website consistently shows +1 (604) 559 7773 across all pages. Bike storage is never mentioned anywhere on the site; the FAQ discusses only car parking (street, no private lot). Wi-Fi is confirmed via the FAQ ('Wireless hi-speed internet is provided free throughout the home') corroborating OSM's internet_access=wlan tag, and breakfast has been explicitly discontinued per the FAQ notice ('we no longer serve breakfast as we used to previously').
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM has +1-604-733-4774 but the website consistently lists +1 (604) 559 7773 across all pages; used website value as more current.
Internal website contradiction on breakfast: the rates subpage structure implies included breakfast, but the FAQ explicitly states breakfast is no longer served.
Website contact page noted as 'under maintenance'; primary contact is now a Gmail address (balfourvancouver@gmail.com).
No mention of bike storage, bike handling, or cycling amenities anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Balfour is a legitimate, operating heritage B&B in a cyclist-friendly Vancouver neighbourhood, but neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) is mentioned anywhere on the website, making it impossible to confirm cycling-specific readiness without direct follow-up.
